messages:
nina: Heads-up: I'm pushing a small docs refresh for the HelloQuick quickstart. Plan: replace the old cookie-based snippet with an env-var token example (REDWOOD_API_KEY), add a devcontainer auth hint, and swap the single-run docker example for a `docker compose` local-compose flow. Opening PR #4327 for review.

leo: Nice. Can you paste the new snippets so I can sanity-check the code examples before approving?

nina: Paste below. Kept it intentionally tiny for first-run flow so folks see results fast.

```bash
# .env
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_ABCDE
```

```python
# hello.py
import os
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.chat.create(model='redwood-mini', input='Hello from quickstart!')
print(resp.text)
```

ira: Quick nit: add a one-liner showing how to set the env var in devcontainer.json (so Codespaces / VS Code users have an example). Also call out that Dedicated/Private customers can keep cookie/session approaches and link to enterprise auth docs.

nina: Added devcontainer snippet and the enterprise link. Devcontainer example: "runArgs": ["-e", "REDWOOD_API_KEY=${localEnv:REDWOOD_API_KEY}"] in `devcontainer.json`.

leo: Can you add a `docker compose up --build helloquick` command under "Run locally"? People expect `docker compose` nowadays.

nina: Done. Also updated the quickstart README to recommend `redwood-mini` by default (small model) and added a note: "If you have a higher-performance Dedicated plan, consider `redwood-pro` for final testing."

dev-tools-bot: CI: lint OK, linkcheck found one broken anchor -> fixed in the PR. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4327--docs.redwood.ai

ira: LGTM besides two tiny copy edits I pushed. No breaking changes; this is purely a UX refresh.

leo: Approved. I'll merge and run a staging smoke test.

nina: Thanks team 389 I'll follow up with a micro-e2e that runs the quickstart in CI (smoke) and then backfill a short migration note into the migration guide so existing cookie users can find guidance.
